aup.title: Acceptable Use Policy
aup.subtitle: Guidelines to ensure a safe, secure, and professional environment for all {site} hosting customers.

content.0: The Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) clarifies the limitations on the use of {site}'s network, hosting infrastructure, and hosted applications. It is designed to protect our services, our clients, and the broader internet community from irresponsible or illegal activities.
Users are strictly prohibited from using {site} services for:
content.1: Spamming: Sending unsolicited bulk emails or marketing messages without verified consent.
content.2: Security Threats: Attempting to bypass authentication, scanning for vulnerabilities, or launching DDoS attacks against any system.
content.3: Resource Abuse: Excessive use of server resources that degrades performance for other clients on shared hosting or cloud servers.
content.4: Illegal Content: Storing or distributing copyrighted material without authorization, or hosting content that promotes violence or illegal acts.

content.0: For the control panel and the applications we provide:
content.1: You may not share administrative accounts with unauthorized third parties.
content.2: Automated scraping of data from our control panel is prohibited unless through an authorized API.
content.3: Any attempt to reverse engineer or modify the control panel source code is a violation of our intellectual property.

content.0: Servers provided by {site} must not be used for hosting malware, phishing pages, or high-risk financial schemes (SCAM/HYIP).
content.1: IRC bots, crypto-mining scripts, and proxy servers are generally prohibited on shared hosting plans as they impact overall infrastructure stability.

content.0: {site} reserves the right to monitor account activity to ensure compliance with this AUP. Violation of these rules may result in immediate suspension or termination of services without notice.
content.1: We cooperate with law enforcement agencies and third-party security entities to investigate and resolve security breaches or illegal activities originating from our network.

contact.title: Reporting Abuse
contact.description: If you witness or suspect a violation of this policy originating from our network, please contact our security team.
